FN-LF19YW-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 5
Committee: Confirmations Sponsor: Senator Steve Livingston
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 07/17/2023
Senate Bill 5 as introduced provides for the reapportionment and redistricting of Alabama's U.S.
Congressional districts. This bill will not affect state or local funding.
Page 1

Committee: Confirmations Sponsor: Senator Steve Livingston
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 07/18/2023
Senate Bill 5 as reported by the Committee on Confirmations provides for the reapportionment
and redistricting of Alabama's U.S. Congressional districts as well as legislative findings
regarding redistricting principles. This bill will not affect state or local funding.
